entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Good evening...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ms. Kawakami...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: A teacher and her student... So this[n]sort of thing really does happen, huh?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hello.
Have a seat.
I'll make you some coffee.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Thanks.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So... you really are back. It's only hitting[n]me now that I actually see you.
Master's home.
Sorry to worry you.
I've missed you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Welcome home.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, so you do have some self-[n]awareness.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I missed that honesty. And, well...[n]I missed you too.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It was clear from the start that you'd be[n]a lot to trouble, but I never expected[n]you to turn yourself in...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: When I heard about it, I... I kind of[n]broke down. God, can you imagine?[n]I cried like a schoolgirl.
Sorry.
My bad.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Usually, I'd give you a written apology[n]due tomorrow, but... I guess you had[n]your reasons. So this time, it's fine.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Anyway. The real reason I'm here...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Homemade chocolate, specially made.[n]With plenty of love and warmth.
This is incredible.
So, melting?
Made with love, huh?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, I like your honesty.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Ugh, you know what I mean! It was[n]meant to be romantic, you doof!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Of course. Not as a maid or anything,[n]but from me personally.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I know I said it already, but... I'm[n]glad to see you're doing okay.
Right back at you.
Of course I'm doing well.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: We're so busy preparing[n]for graduation and[n]entrance ceremonies...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Still, at least that kept my mind off[n]worrying about you...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You're going back home next month?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That means we won't be able to see each[n]other at school anymore...
I'll see you again soon.
I'm not your student now.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: As long as you're not going back to[n]prison, I guess it's not that big a deal.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That's... true, I guess. Doesn't make this[n]any less complicated, though...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey... Something's different about you,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's not exactly your behavior, it's...[n]Hm, it's hard to describe.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, I guess people change.[n]After all, I did too...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: My students are still important to me.[n]I can fight for them. But now... I've got[n]someone I'd do anything for.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I've never really felt like this toward[n]anyone before.
Who?
Are you talking about...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hope he realizes how lucky he is.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Let's stay like this. Just a little longer...
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Kawakami...
